notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-5, review report (Forvis Mazars) p.6. Units differ: the statement of profit or loss (p.9) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, one portfolio (non-participating). Revenue 2.2.1 p.15 and expenses p.16 (3 months, both years). CSM roll-forward 2.3.1.2 p.21-22 (31 มีนาคม 2569); new business 2.3.1.3 p.25. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). The tax line is 'income tax income' this quarter (9,895,914 Baht, a credit); kept positive. RA release uses 2.2.1 (LRC basis, 8,892), not the AOC RA (10,176). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
